name: failed-job-responder
description: When any automation run fails, explains what went wrong in plain language, suggests a fix and tells the team, without repeating itself for the same error.

howItWorks.label: Trigger
howItWorks.text: Any automation run in the project fails

howItWorks.label: Does
howItWorks.text: Reads the failed run and works out the likely cause

howItWorks.label: Suggests
howItWorks.text: A concrete fix: reconnect a plugin, update a field name, adjust the instructions

howItWorks.label: Notifies
howItWorks.text: The automation's owner, and a Slack channel if you pick one

plugins.reason: Posts the failure and suggested fix to a channel

parameters.label: Slack channel
parameters.description: Optional; without it the explanation goes to the run notification only

parameters.label: Quiet period for repeat failures (hours)
parameters.description: The same automation failing for the same reason within this window is summarised, not re-posted

parameters.label: Automations to ignore
parameters.description: Comma-separated automation names that should not be reported
